The plate is a paper plate about 15-18 cm across, which is roughly 260 px in the image, so about 15 px per cm. Each almond is about 35 px long, or roughly 2.3 cm, which is a normal almond size.

I count about 30 almonds. At about 1.2 g each, that comes to roughly 36 g.

Almonds have about 6 kcal per gram, so 36 g is roughly 210 kcal.
